gaps.answer: No sooner had he been elected
gaps.lead: He was elected, and he broke his first promise immediately.
gaps.sentence: ___ than he broke his first promise.

gaps.lead: The ceremony will take place in the cathedral.
gaps.explanation: Ceremonies are held: will be held (in a venue).

gaps.lead: I'd love to be lying on a beach right now.
gaps.sentence: I ___ lying on a beach right now.
gaps.explanation: wish + past subjunctive: I wish I were (formal 'were', not 'was').

gaps.lead: Somebody is repairing our roof at the moment.
gaps.explanation: Somebody else is doing it for us: we are having our roof repaired.

gaps.lead: She was made to wait for two hours.
gaps.explanation: 'Was made to wait' has the same meaning as 'had to wait'.
